name: grc-foundation-ua
title: GRC foundation for Ukraine: legal sources and ISMS mappings

resources.name: readable
resources.title: Everything in one readable workbook
resources.description: For people: the register, the chains and the mappings for each framework with act names, requirement texts and control names joined in. Generated at publication by scripts/build.py.

resources.name: sources
resources.description: Register of legal and normative sources (one row per act), Ukrainian law plus EU acts as a separate reference scope.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable ID, lowercase. Pattern: ua-<type>-<number>-<year>, ua-law-<number>-<convocation>, ua-ndtzi-<code>, nato-<code>. Never reuse or rename once published.

fields.name: register_no
fields.description: Register number shown on the site (No.). Unique, never reused; continues the numbering of the original register.

fields.name: eli
fields.description: European Legislation Identifier. EU acts: the official ELI (http://data.europa.eu/eli/...). Everything else: this project's unofficial ELI-pattern path relative to the site root, eli/<jurisdiction>/<agent>/<type>/<year>/<number>; Ukraine has no official ELI yet. Unique and permanent.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: core (Ukrainian legislation, international agreements, NATO) | reference (EU acts and proposals; never used in the controls table).

fields.name: domain
fields.description: cybersecurity | records (records management requirements relevant to an integrated management system).

fields.name: type
fields.description: Source type, see source_types.csv.

fields.name: number
fields.description: Official number of the act.

fields.name: adopted
fields.description: Adoption date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: registered
fields.description: Ministry of Justice registration date, if any.

fields.name: short_ref_uk
fields.description: Short citation in Ukrainian.

fields.name: short_ref_en
fields.description: Short citation in English.

fields.name: title_uk
fields.description: Official title (Ukrainian).

fields.name: title_en
fields.description: English title (translation).

fields.name: description_uk
fields.description: What the act is about (one or two sentences).

fields.name: description_en
fields.description: Same in English (informal translation).

fields.name: concerns_uk
fields.description: Who the act concerns, in words.

fields.name: concerns_en
fields.description: Same in English.

fields.name: comment_uk
fields.description: Author's comment: status notes, changes, key dates (Ukrainian).

fields.name: status
fields.description: in_force | repealed | not_yet_in_force (e.g. treaty not ratified) | draft (bill or EU proposal) | unknown.

fields.name: binding
fields.description: mandatory | recommended.

fields.name: role
fields.description: requirements (contains obligations) | context (background, defines the system) | procedural | amending (only amends other acts).

fields.name: text_access
fields.description: public | restricted (no public text, e.g. 'ДСК' or NATO INV).

fields.name: url
fields.description: Link to the official text (zakon.rada.gov.ua preferred).

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Topic tags separated by ';'.

fields.name: last_verified
fields.description: Date the row was last checked against the official text.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Maintainer notes.

resources.name: source-types
resources.description: Types of sources and their issuers.

fields.name: actor
fields.description: Id of the body in actors.csv that issues acts of this type

resources.name: sectors
resources.description: Who requirements concern (entity types). 'parent' may list several parents separated by ';'; selecting a narrower type also includes its parents and 'general'.

resources.name: sector-groups
resources.description: Groups of entity types for the filter.

resources.name: applicability
resources.description: Which sectors a source applies to (many-to-many).

fields.name: basis
fields.description: Why it applies / where the assignment came from.

fields.name: verified
fields.description: yes once checked by a maintainer.

resources.name: source-relations
resources.description: Regulatory chains as ELI metadata: source_id <relation> related_id, where relation is an ELI ontology 1.5 property. based_on and the implementation properties (transposes, applies, ensures_implementation_of) build the hierarchy; amends, repeals and the rest are shown alongside.

fields.name: relation
fields.description: ELI property: based_on (empowered by an enabling act) | amends | repeals | transposes (EU directive) | applies (conforms with, e.g. an EU regulation) | ensures_implementation_of (e.g. a treaty, a strategy) | commences | cites | related_to | adopts (ELI-DL: law adopted from a bill). Links from drafts are proposed changes.

fields.name: basis_uk
fields.description: Legal basis or evidence, e.g. the preamble wording

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Where the link was established

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: high (from the act itself) | medium (secondary sources)

resources.name: chains
resources.description: Key chains: narrated paths through the register (for example, how a law leads to the baseline cyber protection measures). Steps are in chain_steps.csv.

resources.name: chain-steps
resources.description: Steps of the key chains, in order: the act, the provision that matters and what it does in the chain.

fields.name: chain_id
fields.description: chains.id

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: sources.id

fields.name: ref_uk
fields.description: provision of the act that matters for this chain

fields.name: role_uk
fields.description: what the act does in the chain

resources.name: actors
resources.description: Map of the national cybersecurity system: the bodies (actors), grouped in bands (coord: coordination and policy; main: the main bodies of the national cybersecurity system; other: other participants), with their role and legal basis. Draft: verified=no until checked against the acts.

resources.name: actor-relations
resources.description: Relations between the bodies on the map (coordinates, directs, cooperates, member_of, agrees_with), with the act (source_id) or document (basis_url) they come from.

resources.name: actor-acts
resources.description: Acts linked to a body on the map: establishes (sets up the body or its powers) or addressed (the act's duties fall on the body rather than on organisations). Acts a body issues come from source_types.csv (column actor).

resources.name: provisions
resources.description: Provisions (requirements) of acts. Generated at publication from the «Вимоги» sheets of mappings/*.xlsx; edit the workbooks, not this file.

fields.name: id
fields.description: <source_id>:<local ref>, e.g. ua-cmu-373-2006:p7.

fields.name: ref_uk
fields.description: Paragraph reference as cited (п. 7, ст. 5 ч. 2).

fields.name: provision_type
fields.description: substantive (an obligation; map it) | delegating (only delegates to another act; link the child act instead) | definitional (scope/terms; do not map).

fields.name: applies_to
fields.description: Optional ';'-separated sectors if narrower than the source's applicability.

resources.name: mappings
resources.description: Provision-to-control mappings (NIST IR 8477; the provision is the focal element). Generated at publication from the framework sheets of mappings/*.xlsx; edit the workbooks, not this file. An empty control_id with no_relationship means no counterpart in the framework.

fields.name: control_id
fields.description: Control id; empty only with relationship=no_relationship, meaning the provision was checked against the whole framework and has no counterpart (a requirement that needs its own policy clause).

fields.name: relationship
fields.description: equal | subset_of (provision narrower than control) | superset_of (provision broader) | intersects_with | no_relationship.

fields.name: rationale
fields.description: semantic | syntactic | functional (NIST IR 8477).

fields.name: strength
fields.description: Optional 1-10.

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: Does implementing the control fully satisfy the provision? full | partial | none.

fields.name: parameter_uk
fields.description: Value the law sets for an organisation-defined parameter (e.g. 'не рідше 1 разу на рік').

fields.name: parameter_en
fields.description: Same in English.

fields.name: policy_uk
fields.description: Suggested internal document (policy, procedure) where the requirement belongs.

fields.name: policy_en
fields.description: Same in English.

fields.name: mapped_by
fields.description: Who made the mapping; AI-generated rows start with 'AI'.

fields.name: review_status
fields.description: ai_draft (generated by AI, not yet read by a person) | draft (written by a person, not yet reviewed) | imported (from the legacy matrix) | reviewed (checked by a second person, see reviewed_by).

resources.name: frameworks
resources.description: Supported frameworks.

resources.name: controls-iso27001-2022
resources.description: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 clauses and Annex A controls. Labels are the project's own short wording; ISO text is not reproduced.

resources.name: controls-csf-2.0
resources.description: NIST CSF 2.0 functions, categories and subcategories (EN: NIST; UA: SSSCIP Order No. 75/2026).

resources.name: sp800-53-baselines-ua
resources.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls with Ukrainian baseline profiles: open = SSSCIP Order 409/2025, dsk = Order 419/2025, nato = Order 843/2025; *_params_uk hold the parameter values.

resources.name: sp800-53-map-csf-2.0-sp800-53r5
resources.description: NIST informative reference: NIST CSF 2.0 to NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.

resources.name: sp800-53-profiles
resources.description: Where system-level requirements come from. kind=baseline: an SSSCIP baseline security profile, whose controls and parameters are the column <id> and <id>_params_uk of baselines_ua.csv; kind=sector: a sector security profile (same columns; none approved yet); kind=plan: the act whose provisions are the mandatory measures of the cyber protection plan (their NIST CSF subcategories expand to NIST SP 800-53).

fields.name: kind
fields.description: baseline | sector | plan

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: The act that approves the profile (sources.csv).

resources.name: eli
resources.title: ELI metadata (JSON-LD)
resources.description: Generated at publication by scripts/build.py from sources.csv and source_relations.csv: every act as eli:LegalResource (drafts as eli:Work) with its ELI, type, dates, force and the regulatory chains as ELI ontology 1.5 / ELI-DL properties.
